title: introduce-incremental-kv-cache-profiler-and-differential-cost-profiles
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We need lower-noise, model-aware attribution of token-level cost and latency where KV cache behavior skews per-tenant and per-model variant. This PR adds an incremental KV cache profiler that collects lightweight, windowed hit/miss histograms and exposes differential cost profiles so SREs, platform, and customers can see how cache dynamics shift effective token cost across rollouts and quantization variants. Design: 1) Profiler: a non-blocking sampler inside the serving runtime that emits metrics prefixed with rw.kvprofiler.*. Instead of full-span hydration we sample per-request at controlled rates and maintain fixed-size ring histograms per model+route. Metrics emitted: rw.kvprofiler.hit_rate_windowed, rw.kvprofiler.miss_latency_p50/p90, rw.kvprofiler.hot_prefix_cardinality. 2) Differential cost profiles: a small post-aggregation job in telemetry that computes per-model delta from baseline for cost-per-token and latency-per-token for the last-1h/24h windows and stores them in a compact table (telemetry.cost_profiles). 3) Dashboards and alerting: added a new dashboard with a side-by-side delta view (token-cost vs baseline) and two pragmatic alerts: (a) persistent >25% delta for 3 consecutive 10m windows (warning), (b) >50% delta + increased error rate (critical). Rollout plan: - gated rollout on Dedicated clusters with feature flag rw.kvprofiler.enabled=false by default - start sampling at 0.1% global, increase on a tenant-by-tenant basis using rate multiplier - redact tenant IDs from metrics; expose tenant-scoped metrics via opt-in telemetry pipeline - 2-week canary on non-critical tenants, then 4-week ramp to reserved capacity. Backwards compatibility: profiler emits only new metrics and does not change request/response wire format. No breaking changes. Testing: unit tests for histogram compaction and sampler backpressure; integration test simulating KV cache warm/cold startup and validating emitted metrics; end-to-end smoke against a staging telemetry pipeline. Benchmarks: observed 0.12% CPU p99 cost on a 16GB serving shard at 0.5% sampling, and no measurable tail latency impact in local perf runs. Security & privacy: metrics are aggregated and bucketed; tenant identifiers are hashed for internal correlation and omitted from exported dashboards unless explicitly enabled. Documentation: added observability/kv-profiler.md with configuration knobs and debugging steps.
